notes.note: First under 120 in his last three games with 14 of his 22 disposals being handballs. He was tagged in the game by Allan which did kerb his influence.
First back to back over 100 since rounds 8 and 9 for LDU. 31 disposals and a game high 16 contested possessions.
Big game for LDU with this his best so far and his second over 140. 11 tackles and 10 clearances was a huge part of his game.
LDU was playing on Taranto and had just the 18 disposals with this his lowest output for the season so far.

LDU had 9 tackles to lead that category in the match as well as 20 disposals. He was talked about as a good value pick and his price didn't rise thanks to a high BE. Could still be an option with the Roos having a good run.
LDU was considered a hot target this week as he has been scoring well and has a good run coming up but this week he couldn't get it going against the Dockers with his 20 disposals coming at just 60%.
LDU was the best for the Roos with his 30 disposals coming at 90% and helped by kicking the goal that levelled the scores. Add to that a team high 7 clearances.
LDU was one of just two Roos to crack 90 points with 22 disposals including 16 handballs.
LDU was the recipient of the tag from Jordon this week but it didn't slow him down as he top scored in the game with 34 disposals and 6 clearances. His second 130+ this year.
LDU was one of just two Roos over 100 with his 24 disposals this week. His scoring has been good this season apart from last week's hiccup.
LDU had his first under 100 and it was by some distance. This could be a one off so you could be ok to hold still for one week to see what happens.
LDU is still yet to drop under 100 and is having a great season. 26 disposals at 92% means he is a solid option.
LDU is yet to drop below 110 this season and is really putting his hand up as a potential great lowly owned pick for you this year.
16 contested possessions this week to go with 22 disposals and 6 tackles as he led the game in clearances with 9. 4 straight scores over 100 for the Roos star. He could be one we have to have.
LDU continued his great start to the season and is lowly owned at just 6.5% so he is a handy own for those that have him.
LDU racked up again this week with his 23 disposals. He is having a good start to the season and he could be in the mix for us.
LDU had a couple of really good patches in the game and is showing some great form. A good 24 disposals.
